etymologies.etymologyHTML:
From late Middle English garbage (“the offal of a fowl, giblets, kitchen waste”, originally “refuse, what is purged away”), from Anglo-Norman, from Old French garber (“to refine, make neat or clean”), of Germanic origin, from Frankish *garwijan (“to make ready”).

Akin to Old High German garawan (“to prepare, make ready”), Old English ġearwian (“to make ready, adorn”). More at garb, yare, gear

definitions.definition: Food waste material of any kind.
Useless or disposable material; waste material of any kind.
A place or receptacle for waste material.

quote.citation: 1966, Owen Chadwick, The Victorian Church, volume 1, page 103:
quote.text: The dissenting Christian Advocate asked (5 January 1835) how a cabinet composed of the very garbage of Toryism could be expected to share the spirit of Peel’s manifesto.

definitions.definition: (obsolete) The bowels of an animal; refuse parts of flesh; offal.
(sports, slang, Canada, US, attributive) An easy shot.

quote.text: Yet, even without the three second rule, where your big man could camp underneath and take those delightful “garbage” shots, there was little or no pivot offense, no cutting off the bucket.

quote.citation: 1981, Update 1981: The Great Contemporary Issues, New York Times Company, page 78:
quote.text: […]  the aging pro, in a much-heralded "boys against the girls" tennis match, annihilated Margaret Court with an array of "garbage shots and cotton balls."

definitions.definition: (transitive, chiefly US, Canada, obsolete) to eviscerate

quote.citation: 1674, John Josselyn, Two Voyages to New England, Made During the Years 1638-63 (quoted in William Butts Mershon, The Passenger Pigeon, 1907, The Outing Publishing Company):
quote.text: I have bought at Boston a dozen Pidgeons ready pulled and garbidged for three pence.

quote.text: If you have been with a man for more than five years and both of you have not planned to marry one another, the relationship is completely garbage, and you can do but nothing with it more than having a sexual life with one another.
